# BRIC.News

> An independent Columbus, Ohio real estate investor publication. News, policy updates, a curated business directory, resources, and guides — reported in a neutral editorial voice, free to read.

## Editorial structure

Five non-overlapping content types, each with its own section:

- **News** (`/news`) — Columbus-metro market data, development, and investor events.
- **Policy** (`/policy`) — Policy, permits, and regulation changes across Columbus municipalities.
- **Business Directory** (`/business-directory`) — Curated directory of Columbus-area businesses investors use (real estate, property management, maintenance, legal, lending, insurance, etc.).
- **Resources** (`/resources`) — Government portals, tax payment sites, court records, market data sources, and event calendars for Columbus investors.
- **Guides** (`/guides`) — Evergreen how-to articles for Columbus investors and landlords.

## How items are produced

BRIC is a pointer, not a republisher. Each item is an original summary written from the facts in a publisher's reporting, a "why it matters" line for Columbus investors, and a link to the original story with the publisher named. Items are gathered daily from publisher RSS feeds and news searches in three tiers (local Columbus metro, Ohio statewide, national), scored for relevance against a published rubric, drafted with AI assistance, and reviewed before publishing. BRIC honors robots.txt, skips paywalled sources, and removes any publisher that asks. Full policy: `/about#editorial`.

Machine-readable feeds: `/rss.xml` (latest 50 items) and `/sitemap.xml`.

## Voice and editorial standards

Every news and policy item follows a two-voice pattern:
1. A neutral, factual newswire summary (≤ 100 words) covering what happened, who, where, when.
2. An educational "Why it matters" line (1-2 sentences) written as a knowledgeable Columbus investor friend helpfully explaining the implication.

Columbus-first framing. Specific numbers, never "significant" without a figure. No hype adjectives, no AI buzzwords, no absolutes. If facts are uncertain, BRIC says so. Corrections are noted on the item.

## Coverage area

Columbus metropolitan area in Central Ohio. Thirteen municipalities have dedicated hub pages; additional places (Powell, Whitehall, Canal Winchester, Granville, Grandview Heights, etc.) are covered by county.

Primary counties: Franklin, Delaware, Licking.

## Business directory policy

- All listings are free.
- "Preferred" designations are editorial picks based on stated criteria, not paid placements. At most one Preferred vendor per category.
- Vendors can request removal within seven days.
- BRIC does not publish vendor reviews or star ratings.

## Sponsorship and partner disclosure

BRIC.News accepts no sponsorship for news coverage. It is an independent publication.

BRIC has an editorial partnership with RL Property Management (rlpmg.com), its Preferred property-management pick. With permission, educational posts from RL's blog are adapted into BRIC items, labeled "Partner" on the site, linked to the original, and kept out of top-story slots. Details: `/about#partners`.

## About the operator

BRIC.News is operated by Andrew Swensen, a Columbus-based marketing strategist. The publication is editorially independent of any property management company.
